summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called VK2735 for weight management in adults who have Type 2 diabetes and are overweight or obese. The study is a Phase 3 Active, not recruiting trial sponsored by Viking Therapeutics, Inc. with an enrollment of 1100 participants. During the 78-week study, participants will receive either the study drug or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the medicine.
